calls.title: Apr 16, 02:01 PM
calls.summary: The team discussed the product launch strategy for Growth Book 4.4, establishing a narrative centered on AI-human collaboration and the new API capabilities. Key updates included the introduction of an AI Data Analyst feature enabling natural language data querying without SQL, and a need for consistent messaging around this feature. To enhance viewer engagement, short videos will replace webinars for the launch, addressing previous low attendance. Updates to the website, including incorporating new AI messaging and visuals on key pages, were outlined. The launch is targeted for the end of April, contingent upon product readiness, with team roles to be coordinated in an upcoming call.
calls.keywords: AI Data Analyst, Growth Book 4.4 Launch, Website Updates, Agentic Workflows, Feature Flagging, API Integration
